measurement.generation: prefix plus 128 predetermined GPU-token decode calls, no sampling
measurement.timing: synchronized perf_counter wall time; input staging/gather/H2D included; setup and reporting excluded
measurement.historical: explicit --prefill-workload historical, full logits no cache; excluded from primary matrix
measurement.memory: before/after live outputs and KV, GPU peak across timed calls, all cached offloaders, raw table snapshots, host RSS; host HWM is process lifetime

acceptance: At least three independent alternating process pairs; repeatable improvement in >=1 primary latency with no resolved regression in the other and preserved offload memory savings; complete matrix for retained candidate.
correctness: Placement changes bit-exact logits/hidden/KV vs independent folded resident. Padded rotary K undefined at masked negative positions; compare valid KV and all hidden/logits; unpadded KV fully compared.
bounded_campaign: After A0000, profile primary workloads and evaluate up to three focused algorithmic candidates before full-matrix confirmation and artifact synthesis; unresolved/failed campaigns remain explicitly incomplete.
